north.evidence: Fig. 18, Rao 1979 MASI 78 vol. I, printed page 112 (PDF page 123): a compass-rose disc with an arrow through it, arrowhead pointing to the page left, at the upper left of the plan. No letter N and no legend or text stating true or magnetic north was found on the figure.
